title: Credit Card Replacement Shipping Options and Fees
summary: This document lists credit card replacement delivery timeframes and expedited shipping fees. Standard delivery is 7–10 business days and free for all cardholders; expedited is 2–3 business days with tier-based fees ($15 Bronze/Eco/Business Bronze, $10 Silver/Business Silver/Green/Silver Zoom, $0 Gold/Platinum/Diamond and above).
